summary: Text button with optional leading and trailing content, for commands, toggles and popup triggers.

usage.text: The attributes aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-haspopup and aria-pressed (or the matching properties) set on the host are forwarded to the inner button. Use them for disclosure, menu and toggle buttons.

a11y.text: The slotted text is the accessible name. For an icon-only button set the ariaLabel property in script: it has no attribute, and an aria-label attribute on the host is not forwarded.
The ariaLabelledby and ariaDescribedby properties have no attributes, and their ids are written onto the button inside the shadow root, where ids from the page do not resolve.
